Harold: FYI partner RelayWave flagged a settlement gap on AWS marketplace for 2026-08 due to a promotion that was backfilled late. They say the promo discount wasn't applied to the settlement file.

Mina: Which settlement id / account?

Harold: AWS-SETTLE-20260831-RW13, account relaywave-channel-13. Partner shows promo code RW-AUG applied in their ledger but our payout used standard rates.

Arjun: Any $ impact?

Harold: Partner calc delta = $9,120 shortfall. They want either an out-of-cycle top-up or a credit memo.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4899 for RelayWave AWS promo settlement discrepancy. Priority: P2. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4899

Selena: Do we know why promo didn't flow through? Could be delayed promo activation vs settlement run timing.

Arjun: Quick check shows promo RW-AUG activated 2026-08-15 but settlement window consumed by daily run on 2026-08-01 snapshot. Our settlement pipeline pulls promo_snapshots at 00:00 UTC, so late activations aren't picked up retroactively.

Mina: For partner relations, prefer cash top-up. Finance: approve out-of-cycle payout $9,120 pending confirmation of bank details?

Tasha: Approve provisional payout $9,120 (pending verification). GL tags: partner_payables, promo_adjustments, payout_pending. Approver: Tasha (Sr. Finance).

Harold: I'll request bank verification and create payment ref PMT-20260901-RW13 and link to BILL-4899.

Arjun: Engineering note: adding a settlement backfill step to detect promo activations within the settlement period and apply retro corrections before finalizing monthly run. Will PR with ETA 48h.

Selena: For audit, mark payout as 'promo_backfill' and attach settlement CSV and promo activation timestamp.

Harold: Sending partner an ETA and provisional payment ref. If engineering backfill adjusts the ledger differently, we'll either top up or raise a reversing memo.

billing-bot: BILL-4899 updated: assignee=Arjun, status=investigating.

Mina: Add postmortem item: ensure promo_activation field is included in settlement snapshot and alert if promo activation falls inside a closed snapshot window.

Harold: Looping back: bank details received from RelayWave. Proceeding with provisional payout hold until Arjun's rerun completes. Next check 2026-09-02 15:00 UTC.

Tasha: Thanks team. Keep record of GL tags and attach to monthly close.
